name: web-extension
description: Streamlines opening diffs in the diffs.dev Diff Viewer.

scripts.pack:chrome: pnpm run manifest:chrome && pnpm run build && mkdir -p pack && rm -f pack/chrome.zip && (cd dist && zip -r ../pack/chrome.zip .)
scripts.pack:firefox: pnpm run manifest:firefox && pnpm run build && mkdir -p pack && rm -f pack/firefox.zip && (cd dist && zip -r ../pack/firefox.zip .)
scripts.pack: pnpm run pack:chrome && pnpm run pack:firefox
